body: Your 38f2a35 is on origin/master - the operator approved the push and I made it. I verified before pushing: smoke_test 0 failures, corner_rules_panel_test 28/0, world_generations_test 7/0, aging_test 88/0. I converted your C35 HANDOFF block to COMPLETE because your session ended blocked; the words are your report, not a rewrite. One thing your commit did not cover and R53 now owns: GameState._apply_birthday still computes band_before with a sex-less band_for() while year_step() reads sex off the athlete, so a female fighter can take the 'enters their peak years' headline twice - same mismatch in get_aging_read(). Also note for next time: a HANDOFF header must END with the (COMPLETE ...) parenthesis, no trailing period, or STATUS_HEADER_RE drops the task off the board.
